Coinbase: AI Scam Prevention Agent Blocks Deepfake Elon Musk Tesla Giveaway Scam, Protecting ~$4.7M in Customer Funds According to Coinbase blog, scammers spun up a fake YouTube livestream during Tesla’s "flying car" demo featuring an AI deepfake of Elon Musk promoting a fraudulent crypto-doubling giveaway that drew over 500,000 viewers and prompted hundreds of Coinbase customers to attempt sending millions of dollars within roughly two hours. Coinbase reported that its autonomous AI Scam Prevention Agent—operating with no humans in the loop—detected the high-risk sends in real time and intervened with targeted, context-aware conversations that exposed giveaway mechanics, ultimately stopping ~91% of the funds, or $4.7 million, from leaving customers' accounts. — link

Binance Wallet Launches Anthropic IPO xStocks Event With a 500M USDC Total Subscription Cap Binance Wallet has announced the launch of its Anthropic IPO xStocks event, with subscriptions open from 06:00 to 14:00 (UTC) on November 18. Eligible users can subscribe for tokenized Anthropic shares using USDC, with a minimum subscription of 100 USDC and a total event cap of 500 million USDC. The indicative price is set at 70 to 78 USDC per token, corresponding to an implied valuation of $1.26 trillion to $1.41 trillion. Individual subscription caps are tiered by Binance Wallet Alpha Points—set at 20,000, 100,000, 200,000, and 500,000 USDC for users holding over 0, 40, 100, and 200 points, respectively. Unallocated users will receive a full refund, while allocated users will be charged based on their final allocation and receive the tokens along with any remaining USDC. Token distribution will take place at least two hours after the Nasdaq market opens, with the exact timing to be determined. — link

Highlight Clip: Dragonfly Partner Reflects on Missing Out on Solana’s 4-Cent Seed Round Dragonfly Partner Reflects on Missing Out on Solana’s 4-Cent Seed Round In the November 12, 2026 When Shift Happens episode, Dragonfly managing partner Haseeb said he passed on Solana's seed round at four cents as a VC in 2017 and 2018. He wrote a memo for every deal he passed on; his unusually detailed Solana memo worked through it like homework, yet the result was no investment. He calls this the most common junior-investor mistake: too focused on process, when the answer is wrong. — link

Singapore’s Largest Bank DBS Partners With Circle to Enable Direct USDC Minting and Redemption for Institutional Clients Singapore’s DBS Bank and stablecoin issuer Circle have announced a partnership enabling eligible institutional clients to mint and redeem USDC directly through DBS, with 24/7, near-instant settlement between USD and USDC—eliminating complete reliance on secondary market liquidity. The service is designed to support institutional treasury operations, payment settlements, and liquidity management. Building on their prior participation in the Monetary Authority of Singapore’s (MAS) Project BLOOM, the two firms will also collaborate to advance interoperability across different forms of tokenized money and financial networks. — link
